suite.name: SCG Connection-Rate Suite
suite.description: Measures how fast fresh connections can be established and torn down (connections/second) and the per-connection establishment latency (handshake p50/p99). Connector threads open a connection, complete the establishment handshake (TCP three-way for loopback; the gateway's upstream TLS handshake once that path is wired), then close, churning as fast as possible while a server thread drains them. The 'connections' field sets the connector parallelism, not a steady connection count. This is the connection-setup analogue of the throughput and ping-pong suites: it stresses accept()/handshake cost rather than steady-state data movement. Loopback TCP only — UDP is connectionless and the gateway connrate harness is not wired yet, so those scenarios are skipped with a notice.
suite.author: SESHAT
